text.en: Dog owners express complete confidence in the care provided at Laburnum Kennels. Reviewers report that pets return home clean, happy, and energized rather than stressed or smelly. Handlers highlight that pets are spoiled with seasonal treats, birthday celebrations, and plenty of affection from attending kennel staff.

Clients consistently commend the kennel team for their warm, compassionate, and attentive approach. Reviewers note that long-serving staff treat guest animals as if they were their own pets. First-time boarders appreciate that the team takes extra time to reassure anxious owners and accommodates senior dogs with declining health.

Feedback highlights the kennel premises in Methley for their excellent standards of comfort and hygiene. Reviewers appreciate that dogs from the same household can board together in spacious accommodations with cooling fans in summer and winter warming. Owners praise the clean environment and secure grounds for daily exercise.

q.en: Can dogs from the same household share a kennel?

a.en: Yes, clients confirm that multiple dogs from the same family can comfortably board together in one kennel suite.

q.en: How do staff support first-time or nervous boarders?

a.en: Reviewers report that staff offer free trial acclimatisation visits and provide reassuring updates to put owners at ease.

q.en: Are kennels clean and heated for winter stays?

a.en: Yes, clients praise the immaculate cleanliness of the premises and note heated suites in winter and cooling fans in summer.

q.en: Do owners need to book boarding stays well in advance?

a.en: Clients recommend booking early for peak holiday periods to ensure availability at the facility.
